notes: the first isnad: «قال أبو بكر حدثنا» is Abu Bakr speaking again, the same man, so he is one link (rule 7); Ibn Abi Umar is a co-transmitter at the first level

the second isnad comes after the saying and carries it («وحدثنيه»): two branches joined by «ح», each ending with «كلاهما عن أيوب ... بهذا الإسناد», so they are two more groups (rule 3, rule 4); «أيوب» is the second occurrence
«بهذا الإسناد» is the back reference that points to the first isnad's chain (rule 1)
